The Apostle of Myrkul is a powerful enemy that serves as the final boss of Act Two.
“
I am the smile of the worm-cleansed skull. I am the regrets of those who remain, and the restlessness of those who are gone.
„
— Apostle of Myrkul introducing himself

Involvement

The Apostle of Myrkul must be fought in the Mind Flayer Colony. The  Dream Guardian refers to him as an Avatar of  Myrkul himself, the god of death, who rises after the defeat of  Ketheric Thorm.[1]

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Call of the Damned ()
Damage: 3~30 + modifiers
3d10 + Spellcasting modifier⁠Necrotic
Speak the commands Myrkul whispers in your ear, and pull all nearby creatures 9 m / 30 ft towards you.
 STR Save
 Cold Embrace ()
Damage: 13~47
2d8 + 7⁠Slashing
+ 4d6⁠Cold
Lash out with bone-cold hands.
 Range: 4 m (13 ft)
 Gaze of the Dead ()
Damage: 4~32 + modifiers
4d8 + Spellcasting modifier⁠Necrotic
Cast your empty eyes towards a creature and  Frighten it.
 CON Save
 Range: 30 m (100 ft)
 Recharge: Per turn
 Main Hand Attack ()   –  Scythe of Myrkul
Damage: 9~31
2d12 + 7⁠Slashing
Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon.
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Reaper's Scythe ()
Damage: 12~49
2d12 + 7⁠Slashing
+ 3d6⁠Necrotic
Swing your weapon in a large arc that knocks targets back 4 m / 13 ft.
 STR Save
 Recharge: Per turn

Honour Mode

In Honour mode, Apostle of Myrkul gains a second use of Gaze of the Dead each round as a Legendary Action against the first creature that attacks it.

 Legendary Action: Gaze of the Dead

Once per round, Myrkul's Apostle can spend a Legendary Action to cast  Gaze of the Dead on a creature when attacked.

Immunities

  •  Bleeding
  •  Charmed conditions, such as  Charmed and  Dominated
  •  Chest Trauma
  •  Frightened conditions, such as  Frightened and  Phantasmal Killer
  •  Gaping Wounds
  •  Incapacitated conditions, such as  Frozen and  Banished
  •  Poisoned conditions, such as  Poisoned and  Nauseous
  •  Polymorphed
  •  Prone conditions, such as  Prone and  Hideous Laughter
  •  Sleeping

Achievements

No Free Lunches
Defeat the Apostle of Myrkul before it consumes any necromites.
